item.title: Adversary Emulation
item.description: The techniques of the threat actors most relevant to you, replayed in a controlled way and mapped to MITRE ATT&CK — so you know exactly what your defenses catch.

item.title: Insider Threat Assessment
item.description: A controlled look at how legitimate access could be misused — and whether your governance, controls, and response would prevent or expose it.

item.title: Phishing & Smishing Simulations
item.description: Realistic email and mobile-message campaigns that measure how well people and processes recognize, report, and escalate suspicious messages.

item.title: Red Team Operations
item.description: A realistic, objective-led attack against the systems that matter most — run under strict guardrails, measured against your ability to prevent, detect, and respond.
